name: Under the Murder Tree
source:
I've seen dozens just like Eliot. The dead eyes of someone uncapable of feeling remorse for his actions. He has been in custody for four hours already and I have only five minutes to break him and make him talk...

[from [url=https://banya.itch.io/murdertree]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我见过很多像艾略特一样的人。一个无法为自己的行为感到悔恨的人的死神眼神。他已经被拘留了四个小时，而我只有五分钟的时间来打破他并让他说话……

[来自[url=https://banya.itch.io/murdertree]itch.io[/url]]
